name: Definium Therapeutics, Inc.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed 2026-02-26, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: the investing-activities section lists ONLY Purchases of investments $(268,356) thousand and Maturity of investments $116,750 thousand (net $(151,606) thousand) for 2025, with both lines shown as zero for 2024 and no purchases-of-property-and-equipment line anywhere; the balance sheet carries no property and equipment asset line. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, filed 2025-03-06, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (2024/2023 comparative): the statement has NO investing-activities section at all — for 2023, operating $(64,365) thousand + financing $21,848 thousand + FX $79 thousand equals the reported net decrease in cash $(42,438) thousand, proving investing cash flow (and therefore capex) was $0 in FY2023; same reconciliation for 2024 (operating $(79,129) + financing $253,196 + FX $(30) = reported $174,037 increase).
overrides_applied.reason: Definium has never reported capex or a PPE balance in any filing — EDGAR companyfacts contains no capex fact under any candidate tag in any year — because this asset-light, outsourced clinical-stage model buys no property or equipment. The filings' own cash-flow statements fully account for investing activities (investment purchases/maturities only in 2025; zero investing activity in 2023 and 2024), so capex for the missing FY2023-2025 periods is $0 as a filing fact, not an estimate. Measured impact is nil: the engine's history already carried capex as assumed-zero, so the override changes no OE figure — it converts a silent zero-fill into a sourced, registered decision.

Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, filed 2025-03-06, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (2024/2023 comparative): the statement has NO investing-activities section at all — for 2023, operating $(64,365) thousand + financing $21,848 thousand + FX $79 thousand equals the reported net decrease in cash $(42,438) thousand, proving investing cash flow (and therefore capex) was $0 in FY2023; same reconciliation for 2024 (operating $(79,129) + financing $253,196 + FX $(30) = reported $174,037 increase).); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
